Subject: MAP kickoff: Acme evaluation & target close plan

Hi Emily + Tom,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, I wanted to kick off a formal Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we can align on the evaluation milestones, owners, and a realistic close timeline. I’ve sketched an initial plan attached (ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx) and added a shared Drive folder for collaborative updates.

Proposed cadence: weekly checkpoints (30 min) on Wednesdays, starting next week. Goal: production pilot sign-off by the end of Q2 (target close window: mid-June). Success criteria (rough):
- Pilot completion with latency < 200ms p95 for representative workload
- Verification of data isolation and audit log collection
- Cost estimate and committed throughput for Dedicated pool

Immediate asks:
- Emily: confirm procurement contact and high-level budget timeline so we can map billing/contract milestones into the MAP.
- Tom: confirm demo scope (safety and data residency checks + two sample prompts) and whether we should run a performance runbook during the pilot.
- Priyom: can you own demo environment readiness and provide a target date?
- Jasmine: please prepare a short seq-of-events doc for SOC/Security evidence we’ll need for the pilot.

I’ll update the MAP with owners and the first checkpoint agenda and circulate a calendar invite once Emily confirms availability.

Attachments: ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx (map draft), redwood-demo-access.txt (temp demo creds instructions)

Best,
Rishi
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
